name: model-card
title: Model governance card
for_each: SELECT id,code FROM systems ORDER BY code

sections.title: Version record
sections.sql: SELECT code,model_ref,current,notes FROM versions WHERE system_id=$1 ORDER BY created_at,id

sections.title: Decisions
sections.sql: SELECT state,impact,likelihood,reviewer,decided_on,valid_until,rationale FROM assessments WHERE system_id=$1 ORDER BY created_at,id

name: assessment-record
title: Assessment and evidence record
for_each: SELECT a.id,s.code||'-'||a.id::text AS code FROM assessments a JOIN systems s ON s.id=a.system_id ORDER BY a.created_at,a.id

sections.title: Evidence supplied
sections.sql: SELECT kind,reference,summary,checked_on,valid_until FROM evidence WHERE assessment_id=$1 ORDER BY kind

name: remediation-plan
title: Remediation plan
for_each: SELECT id,code FROM systems ORDER BY code

sections.title: Owner and scope
sections.sql: SELECT code,name,owner,purpose FROM systems WHERE id=$1

sections.title: Actions and resolution
sections.sql: SELECT title,owner,severity,due_on,status,resolution,closed_on FROM actions WHERE system_id=$1 ORDER BY due_on,id
